title: Greater Israel education, state and technical-talent pipeline — depth 6
summary: The surname collision resolves into a relevant Israeli state–philanthropy–industry–defense education network.

data.question: How does the Eddie and Jules Trump Family Foundation connect to the existing Greater Israel dataset?
data.method: Official-source entity resolution and recursive mapping of 5p2, its participants and the stated talent pathway.
data.scope: Foundation, 5p2, founding partners, participant sectors and education-to-IDF-technology funnel.
findings: The foundation is unrelated to Donald Trump but relevant to the Greater Israel institutional graph.
Rashi Foundation and Intel Israel co-initiated 5p2 with the foundation; Sheatufim convened it.
The workshop included education, academic, corporate, defense R&D and Military Intelligence representation.
Almost 100 organizations later joined and 5p2 became a national program.
The foundation describes a path from advanced mathematics into IDF elite technology units and high-tech.
conclusions: This belongs in Greater Israel as a state-capacity and technical-talent pipeline.
The supported model is coordinated philanthropy, industry, government, education and defense-sector participation.
Participation does not prove military control or compulsory recruitment.
recommendations: Recover the complete roster, governance and funding ledger.
Trace Ministry of Education adoption, budgets and ownership.
Resolve public defense and intelligence participants.
counterarguments: The workshop may reflect consultation rather than governance.
The funnel language may be descriptive.
limitations: The national program's legal vehicle is unresolved.
No source links the foundation to Donald Trump.
